name: allura-memory
description: Governed AI memory for Claude Desktop & Cowork. Connects to your hosted Allura Brain for persistent, compliance-grade recall across sessions and runtimes.
long_description: Allura Memory gives Claude Desktop and Cowork a persistent, governed memory backed by Allura Brain — a dual-database (PostgreSQL + Neo4j) memory engine. This extension bundles a lightweight stdio proxy that forwards every memory operation to your hosted Allura Brain over HTTPS, attaching your API key and tenant (group_id). Governance — append-only traces, tenant isolation, and HITL promotion — is enforced server-side, so it travels with you into Desktop automatically. Search before you act; write after you learn.

base_url.title: Allura Brain URL
base_url.description: Your hosted Allura Brain MCP endpoint (streamable HTTP).

api_key.title: API Key
api_key.description: Your Allura Brain API key. Stored securely in the OS keychain.

group_id.title: Tenant (group_id)
group_id.description: Your Allura tenant namespace. Must match ^allura-[a-z0-9-]+$ (e.g. allura-yourname). Auto-attached to memory calls that accept it.
